items.q: How much does a full renovation cost in Sabadell?
items.a: It depends on size and finish level. As a guide, a standard full renovation usually starts at €400-600/m². We prepare a free itemised quote after the technical visit.

items.q: How long does a bathroom renovation take?
items.a: A complete bathroom renovation usually takes 1 to 3 weeks depending on scope: demolition, plumbing and electrics, tiling, fixtures and finishes.

items.q: Can I live at home during the works?
items.a: For most partial renovations, yes, with some planning. For full renovations a temporary alternative is usually more comfortable. We explain it during the visit.

items.q: What does a full renovation include?
items.a: Demolition, masonry, electrics, plumbing, carpentry, flooring, painting, kitchen, bathrooms and final cleaning. All coordinated by a single team.

items.q: Do I need permits to renovate?
items.a: For interior renovations that don't affect the structure, a notice to the town hall is usually enough. We advise you on the permits needed in Sabadell, Barcelona, Terrassa and Mataró.

items.q: What warranty do the materials have?
items.a: We work with first-quality materials with manufacturer's warranty. We also review every finish with you before final handover.

story: Junior Reformas was born from the experience of João Paulo de Oliveira Domingues, with over 15 years dedicated to renovations in Sabadell, Barcelona and surroundings.
He started as a bricklayer and today coordinates a small, stable team of 2 to 5 people covering the whole project: masonry, plumbing, electrics, carpentry, flooring and painting.
Most of our clients come through recommendations. That only happens by caring for every detail and delivering what was promised.

processPage.sub: A process proven on hundreds of projects: clear, tidy and surprise-free.
tips: Use the visit to tell us everything: moving a wall now costs little; later, much more.
We help you choose materials based on your budget and the real use of each room.
Review the breakdown item by item. Ask about anything you don't understand: that's what it's for.
We keep the site tidy and update you on progress with WhatsApp photos.
We walk through every room together before closing. If something isn't right, we fix it.

faq.q: Does the technical visit cost anything?
faq.a: No. The visit is free and without obligation in Sabadell, Barcelona, Terrassa, Mataró and surroundings.

faq.q: How long does the quote take?
faq.a: After the visit, you receive the itemised quote within 3-5 working days.
Junior personally coordinates the whole team: masonry, plumbing, electrics and carpentry. A single point of contact.
We accept bank transfer, cash and card or Bizum. Payments are staggered according to work progress, never everything upfront.
